description: The frontend capability catalog: what the frontend LEGO can offer beyond the pinned editor UI, and how the UI must behave when it is absent. Every entry here is DECLARED — declared is not installed, installed is not loaded, loaded is not active. P2.8-F implements no capability and registers none: this file exists so the identity, criticality, trust level, activation mode and fallback of a future capability are agreed before its code is written. P2.10 declares the AI foundation's frontend-visible capabilities (AI Assistant, Copilot, Agent node, Agent Machine, Execution AI mode, Agent Work Trace) in the same form, so an installation with no model and no runtime is a declared state rather than an error.
notes: An entry describes a capability, never an implementation: metadata only, no render/mount/load functions, no inline code.
`entry` is a module path so the runtime can stay lazy. A capability that is not installed yet declares none.
`criticality: core` may not declare a fallback — a missing core capability must stay visible.
`trust` is inherited by nesting: a sub-LEGO inside a `feature` capability is a feature, never core.

Backend-bound capabilities are NOT re-declared here. The surface catalog already binds a surface to its backend capability and contract (manifest/surfaces.json); duplicating those ids here would create a second source of truth (contract §12).

Features this instance cannot serve are answered by the compatibility layer's unsupported map (apps/n8n-lego/src/compat/capability.mjs), which is the backend-side registry. This catalog never duplicates it.

Locales are declared once, in src/i18n.mjs. The official set is id, en, ar, zh, ru, jv; the legacy micro-frontend.contract.md set (id/en/es/fr/de/ja) is superseded — see contracts/frontend.contract.md §16.1.

Official locales (id, en, ar, zh, ru, jv) and the translation fallback chain are already owned and tested by contracts/localization.contract.md — the frontend declares readiness for that contract, it does not restate it.

capabilities.title: Translation and locale switching

degradation.detail: without the Translation LEGO a surface renders through the fallback chain owned by contracts/localization.contract.md (locale dictionary -> en -> the raw key); an unknown key never throws

capabilities.notes: Declared so the eleven translatable surfaces, the RTL rule and the fallback behaviour are agreed before the Translation LEGO exists. It is not installed, not loaded and not registered — the boot payload must not mention it. The locale set and the fallback chain are owned by contracts/localization.contract.md (agent-9 lineage, TESTED); this frontend never redefines them.

capabilities.title: AI Assistant (in-product conversational help)

degradation.detail: without an inference provider the assistant entry point is not rendered; the editor is unaffected

capabilities.notes: Declared so the UI vocabulary for an AI assistant exists before the AI Foundation LEGO does. The frontend implements no inference and no provider client; `assistant.ask` is a semantic operation, not an endpoint, and the stream interaction is what a token-by-token answer means here. It attaches to no extension point yet: no AI hook is declared, and attaching to a neighbour surface's hook is exactly what the ownership rule refuses.

capabilities.title: AI Copilot (workflow authoring assistance)

degradation.detail: without the capability the editor behaves exactly as it does today; no suggestion is faked

capabilities.notes: An edit the copilot proposes is still an ordinary workflow operation, applied through the workflow capability — the copilot never gets a private write path.

capabilities.title: AI Agent node (a workflow step that delegates to an agent)

degradation.detail: without an agent runtime the node type is not offered in the palette; existing workflows that use it report it through the error model

capabilities.notes: Declared as a node capability, never as a runtime: the node delegates, it does not become the agent machine.

capabilities.title: Agent Machine (runtime that executes delegated tasks)

degradation.detail: executions run exactly as they do today; the UI simply has no agent runtime to offer

capabilities.notes: The frontend learns about the machine through declared capabilities and agent events, never by calling it directly. A local, remote or simulated runtime is the same contract with a different locality.

capabilities.title: Execution AI mode (an execution that is partially agentic)

degradation.detail: the execution page shows the ordinary status; nothing claims an agent was involved

capabilities.notes: A marker on an execution, not a second execution contract: the execution contract itself stays owned by the execution domain.

capabilities.title: Agent Work Trace (operational timeline of delegated work)

degradation.detail: without the capability the execution page shows the ordinary log; no timeline is invented

capabilities.notes: The trace renders operational events, decisions, approvals, artifacts and state transitions. It carries summaries and references; a payload or a chain-of-thought has no field to live in.

capabilities.title: Status region pilot (loading / empty / error)

degradation.detail: without the pilot capability the reference n8n status/error presentation remains primary

capabilities.notes: Issue #241 pilot only: metadata + view-model behind the existing registry/extension seam; original UI stays default. Not installed at boot unless registered by a consumer.

capabilities.title: Shared notification surface (info / success / warning / error / dismissed)

degradation.detail: without the capability the reference n8n toast/banner presentation remains primary

capabilities.notes: Issue #245: one shared notification surface behind the existing registry/adapter seam. Severity (info/success/warning/error) and disposition (shown/dismissed) are separate axes from the region state the parity harness compares. Dismissal removes the notice from the live region rather than adding a sixth region state. Bounded queue; errors are never silently dropped. Not installed at boot unless registered by a consumer; the original n8n editor stays the default path.

capabilities.title: Dashboard workflow-list pilot (loading / empty / error / ready, bounded + filterable)

degradation.detail: without the capability the reference n8n Home workflow list remains primary

capabilities.notes: P2-S03 Layer 3: the first strangler slice, a bounded and client-filtered view-model of the Home workflow list. Rows are handed over (the surface never fetches, so it holds no private data path to the workflow catalog). The four region states reuse REGION_STATES; filtering to zero is `empty` with reason `filtered`, not a fifth state. Opening/toggling a workflow are declared interactions, never executed. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

capabilities.title: Dialogs / overlays pilot (handed-over content, bounded, declared actions by kind)

degradation.detail: without the capability the reference n8n modal/overlay presentation remains primary

capabilities.notes: P2-S03 Layer 3: the second strangler slice, a bounded view-model for modals/overlays. The content is handed over (the surface never fetches, so it holds no private data path to the content's owning capability). The four region states reuse REGION_STATES; a closed dialog is `empty`, not a fifth state. The kind (confirmation/form/notice) decides the declared ready actions. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

capabilities.title: Executions list pilot (loading / empty / error / ready, bounded + status-filterable)

degradation.detail: without the capability the reference n8n executions page list remains primary

capabilities.notes: P2-S03 Layer 3: the third strangler slice, a bounded and status-filterable view-model of the executions page list. Rows are handed over (the surface never fetches /rest/executions, so it holds no private data path to the execution catalog). The four region states reuse REGION_STATES; filtering to zero is `empty` with reason `filtered`, not a fifth state. Opening an execution is a declared interaction, never executed. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

capabilities.title: Node picker / catalog pilot (palette search, closed categories, bounded)

degradation.detail: without the capability the reference n8n node picker remains primary

capabilities.notes: P2-S07 Layer 3: the strangler slice for the node picker palette, a bounded and query-filterable view-model. Node types are handed over (the surface never fetches the node catalog, so it holds no private data path). The four region states reuse REGION_STATES; filtering to zero is empty with reason filtered, not a fifth state. Selecting a node type is a declared interaction with a closed result vocabulary, never executed silently. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

capabilities.title: Workflow editor host pilot (name/tags/active-state header + actions panel)

degradation.detail: without the capability the reference n8n workflow editor remains primary

capabilities.notes: P2-S08 Layer 3: the strangler slice for the editor host chrome around the canvas - the name/tags/active-state header and workflow-level actions panel. The workflow record is handed over read-only (the surface never fetches /rest/workflows/:id and never mutates workflow data; rename/activate are declared interactions returning a closed result vocabulary). The canvas/editor rewrite stays out of scope (issue #241). Four region states reuse REGION_STATES; tag chips are bounded. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

capabilities.title: Credentials list pilot (bounded, visibility-filterable, values never on the surface)

degradation.detail: without the capability the reference n8n credentials page remains primary

capabilities.notes: P2-S09: the strangler slice for the credentials list surface. Rows are handed over as identity metadata only - credential values never reach the surface (a value-bearing row is refused with an explicit security error; the P5/P2.27 envelope and the value-entry editor stay with the reference UI and the credential runtime). The four region states reuse REGION_STATES; visibility filtering to zero is empty with reason filtered, not a fifth state. Create/delete/share are declared interactions with a closed result vocabulary, never executed silently. Mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary.

capabilities.title: Settings panels pilot (instance + personal, secret material never on the surface)

degradation.detail: without the capability the reference n8n settings pages remain primary

capabilities.notes: P2-S10: the strangler slice for the settings surface (instance + personal panels). Entries are handed over through declared settings capabilities only; a secret-bearing entry is refused with an explicit security error (P2.27/P5 secret boundary is finding-only here) and a non-scalar value is refused for the same reason. The four region states reuse REGION_STATES; a panel filtered to zero is empty with reason filtered, not a fifth state. Save/reset are declared interactions with a closed result vocabulary, never executed silently. Mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary.

capabilities.title: Webhooks surface pilot (URL/method/registration shown with a node or workflow)

degradation.detail: without the capability the reference n8n webhook surfaces remain primary

capabilities.notes: P2-S11: the strangler slice for the webhook URL/method/registration surface shown with a node or a workflow. Registrations are handed over through declared capabilities only; the surface issues no register call and a registration carrying auth material is refused with an explicit security error (Webhook node + Credentials runtime own auth). The four region states reuse REGION_STATES; a resource filter to zero is empty with reason filtered, not a fifth state. Copy-url is a declared interaction with a closed result vocabulary, never executed silently. Mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary.
